title: P4 evaluation ground truth
description: Hand-labelled PII for the evaluation set. Matching never uses block_id (uuid4 per run). A prediction matches a label when file, location, pii_type and normalised text agree, and, when the label has a span, the IoU of the spans is at least 0.5. Spans are offsets into the document text for (file, location): the blocks of that file and location joined by newlines, in reading order.

decoys.description: Text that looks like PII but is not. Any prediction whose normalised text contains a decoy counts as a decoy false positive.

location.description: Page number for PDF, slide number for PPTX, null for DOCX.

identity.description: Optional group name. Mentions of the same person share a group. Only meaningful for PERSON.

span.description: Optional [start, end) offsets in the (file, location) joined text.
